message:
feat(keepalive-r2 ②, e): an asynchronous capability -- the lease says it needs one, the app observes from its socket and hands one in

On Android the directory HTTP is the app's (Kotlin DirectoryClient); the native side has no HTTP client. So a lease
whose CapabilityFn gives nothing now marks needsCapability (nothing sent, no entry); its owner observes from THAT
lease's socket (StandbyLease::ObserveFrom / StandbyRunner::Observe -- standby_observe_on moved into standby_lease.hpp)
and hands the capability in (Provide: aim + admission). StatusOf carries needsCapability.
Test: the runner phase of --product-client now runs the APK's way (no capability source, Provide): 63/63 under
sh_run -NativeExe (--real-directory --old-host); entry client 51/51.
